lines.5: 「I'm paying you back for putting me up last night. Next thing I knew, I'd fallen asleep in Leo's room...」
lines.9: 「Making us breakfast and everything. You're a conscientious guy.」
lines.10: I took a sip of Subaru's miso soup.
lines.14: 「So do girls really prefer guys who can cook?」
lines.15: 「Of course. You should learn to cook too.」
lines.16: 「Cooking goes over pretty well. The trick is not to advertise it at first. Then, when your chance comes, you breezily whip something up.」
lines.18: Maybe I should work harder on improving myself too.
lines.20: With a dramatic thrust, Otome held out her bowl.
lines.24: All right. Subaru's cooking has put some energy back into me.
lines.25: Time to give it my all today!
lines.26: Trying to get closer to the Princess had given my days a new sense of purpose.
